capabilities: Export the active canvas as an HTML package or single self-contained file
Preserve canvas layout, styling, and Advanced Canvas attributes in the export
Follow linked subcanvases and wiki links recursively with cycle-safe navigation
Add folding, branch focus, search, minimap, and zoom controls to exported pages
Render Markdown nodes with links, embeds, KaTeX math, and Shiki code highlighting
extras: Desktop-only because exports use local filesystem access. The author accepts donations via Ko-fi. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Preserve supported Advanced Canvas shapes, borders, text alignment, edge paths, edge heads, and saved colors
problem: Canvas files can only be viewed inside Obsidian, so there is no built-in way to share a canvas as a self-contained, viewable HTML document.

relations.evidence: Canvas HTML Exporter reads supported Advanced Canvas attributes directly from the saved .canvas file.
Canvas Folding is an optional companion plugin, not a dependency.

summary: Exports Obsidian canvases as interactive, portable HTML pages or packages with folding, search, navigation, and zoom controls.
